talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 41 solo PCPs winding down in Ohio; 5 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Lakewood 44107, Marietta 45750, Ironton 45638) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~4,786 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Lake County, Lorain County, Clermont County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 10 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~178,800 patients across 149 at-risk practices statewide.
